data.name: Mudrik
data.gender_notes: Mudrik is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mudrik is an Arabic name that symbolizes the blessings of Allah. It is derived from the word 'mudaraka' which means to bless or to grant. The name Mudrik carries the meaning “Divine Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mudrik usually hope their child will grow to embody divine blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The one who is blessed by Allah with guidance and success.
data.etymology: Mudrik belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine Blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mudrik total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
